title: ServiceReliability
description: ISO 25011 quality archetype — IT Service Reliability viability dimension. Degree to which the IT service performs specified functions under specified conditions for a specified period of time. Sub-characteristics: Continuity, IT Service Recoverability, Availability. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing service reliability and SLA targets. Source: ISO/IEC TS 25011:2017 §7.4.

availabilityTarget.description: Service availability target tier. BEST_EFFORT = no SLA. STANDARD_99 = 99% (~87.6h downtime/yr). HIGH_99_9 = 99.9% (~8.76h). CRITICAL_99_99 = 99.99% (~52min). MISSION_CRITICAL_99_999 = 99.999% (~5min).

continuityLevel.description: Degree to which the IT service can be maintained in a running condition during a major disruption. NONE = no continuity plan. BASIC = manual recovery. ENHANCED = automated failover. FULL = continuous operation (zero downtime).

recoverabilityTarget.description: Recovery time objective classification for the IT service. NONE = no defined RTO. HOURS = recovery in hours. MINUTES = recovery in minutes. NEAR_ZERO = near-instantaneous recovery.
